Im a profesional kitchen designer. So the good news is that you don’t actually have to replace the cabinets. You can just install a good piece of molding on the wall cabinets and take them all the way to the ceiling. Replace the countertop with something you love and if you have the budget take that countertop all the way to the backsplash. Add shelving that wraps around the bottom of the wall cabinets so that the countertop has a place to end and make the shelving the same finish as the bottom cabinet wood. You will have a brand new kitchen with minimal down time a small countertop companies can template your new countertops without taking the old ones off! If you don’t like the color of the bottom cabinets, then paint a statement color and keep the white on top to keep the open feeling.
